ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with discrete high-intensity (white) focal points; estimated 95% black to 5% white distribution on the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black surface area across both lobes with scattered, high-contrast white circular and annular blobs (2-6 pixel diameter) concentrated at the lateral tips and sparse in the medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped central depression with an approximate 35-degree internal angle and a depth of roughly 8% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency serrations; a notable secondary deep indentation is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the lower boundaries curving into acute, upward-pointing lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-like high-intensity white clusters; approximately 12-15 discrete markings are scattered across both lobes, with higher density at the lateral extremities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, faint horizontal high-intensity linear mark is visible in the medial-left interior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy colonization of barnacles at the distal tips creates a high-intensity, textured peripheral boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast calcified barnacle clusters at the extreme lateral tips provide a distinctive 'fringed' texture to the fluke's outer perimeter.
